changelog: Cars to Buy — market deal check. Each scouted car is now compared to the median asking price of the SAME make/model across everything you've scouted, and colour-coded: green = good deal (well under market), yellow = decent (around market), red = over market. Cards show a coloured stripe + how many $ under/over, the detail page has a Market check panel, and there's a new '🔥 Best deals' sort that floats the underpriced cars to the top. Asking-price comps (needs a few of the same model to kick in) — a fast screen to find cars worth chasing; confirm true value with your dealer tools.
